name: make-corpus-production

residual.policy: real ERROR/MISSING nodes only; the engine's generic hasError-without-a-node warning is excluded and reported separately

complexityPolicy: one production parseFile pass per acceptance file; the make analyzer uses one iterative DFS over the tree with O(1) Map-backed symbol dedupe (name:kind) and Set-backed relationship dedupe — O(nodes + emitted facts), no per-symbol O(n) scans
